title: Bank operations runbooks and controlled daily processing
workflow: Determine institution business date and approved calendar
Verify starting reconciliation and known open financial exceptions
Run only eligible controlled tasks in dependency order
Capture actual task logs, outputs, snapshots and exceptions
Require independent finance/operations review before closing monetary cycle
Publish signed handoff and next-business-day recovery state
invariants: Clock time cannot automatically certify end-of-day completion
Open suspense or unknown settlement remains visible in reconciliations
No direct alteration of posted journals during operational cleanup
Runbook revisions are effective dated and approval controlled
Interrupted task resumes idempotently from recorded cursor
Operator roles cannot self-certify sensitive finance controls
Customer facing reports must use source-confirmed business date
acceptance_tests: EOD refuses to pass with unreconciled trial balance
Interrupted process restart creates no duplicate charge
Unauthorized operator cannot sign financial closure
Prior day's evidence remains independently retrievable
independent_gate: CFO/Operations endorsed bank calendar, real source reconciliation and executed EOD rehearsal.
